Readiness is observed through actual public reader default-versus-record results and actual retained partial state, not a mocked ready flag. Pending readiness, asynchronous scheduling and concurrent storage/loading are not covered.

Group records are synthetic raw cache inputs. False,zero,empty-string,null,undefined and malformed-batch results characterize source behavior, not config parsing/storage validation, group authorization or server assignment.

Returned snapshot arrays are retained and their includes/at/pop methods observe actual original record identity. No host objects, callbacks, arbitrary code, function handles or raw Map/Set snapshots are injected.
Cross-group histories and cache lifecycles are unbounded. Six generated histories and literal failure/clear/reinit scenarios do not establish all interleavings or account/device behavior.
